item.title: France arrests 565 as youth protests turn violent in Germany and France
item.description: German organisers said 120,000 joined demos, below the 180,000 expected, after Frankfurt and Berlin saw riots, looting and injured police. Ministers blame extremist infiltrators; the movement disowns them.

item.title: Student unions call to block schools after police ban Paris demonstration route
item.description: Education minister Philippe Baptiste rejects the blockade and offers 1 billion euros for building renovations, while five unions have called an intersectoral strike for Thursday 5 November.

item.title: Russia vetoes US draft as UN mission in Western Sahara expires on 31 October
item.description: The Security Council failed to renew MINURSO's mandate for the first time, after Moscow blocked an American text that would have extended the mission to 2027 and removed its referendum role.

item.title: Ukrainian soldiers expect major Russian assault on Kherson as ceasefire ends on 1 Nov
item.description: Soldiers report KamAZ lorries moving combat units non-stop and Grad launchers massing near Radensk during the 80-hour truce, with the deputy governor warning of far heavier shelling from Monday. A civilian evacuation of about 2,000 residents in Oleshky begins Saturday.

item.title: CMPorts overtakes COSCO as Europe counts Chinese stakes in its ports
item.description: A study for the European Parliament put Chinese control at about 10% of European container throughput, and the two leading firms answer to the same state.
